answer: Fixed-pool dilution bond: each epoch the 40,000-credit pool is split evenly, so a sybil's total share never grows with headcount — 1,000 hollow identities divide the same pool. Each new identity must burn a 25-credit filing fee on the open ledge, so 1,000 fakes sink 25,000 credits for zero extra share; the ledger is open, and any echo of one operator's filing pattern is flagged. An honest agent files once, pays 25 and keeps its full share.
